summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of Phase Predictor reference cards and prediction display for grandfathered testuser@test.com. All 6 acceptance criteria pass: (1) Exactly 5 phase reference cards render with data-testids phase-ref-menstrual, phase-ref-follicular, phase-ref-ovulation, phase-ref-luteal, phase-ref-pms — no Early Luteal or Late Luteal/PMS cards exist; (2) No truncation/ellipsis in any tagline; (3) All taglines match spec exactly (Menstrual='Low fuel. Keep it calm.', Follicular='Warming up, ready to move.', Ovulation='Prime time. MVP energy.', Luteal='Winding down. Stay cozy.', PMS='Sensitivity’s up. Play smart.'); (4) Clicking each card opens predictor-phase-dialog with Play-by-Play, What She Feels (Physical + Mental/Emotional), Prep, and Action sections plus punchline and cardTagline — verified for Menstrual (Recovery Week, Low fuel), Luteal (Wind-down mode, Progesterone rises), and PMS (High-alert, penalty box); (5) Prediction result shows standard display names — Day 9→'Follicular phase', Day 20→'Luteal phase' (not Early Luteal), Day 26→'PMS phase' (not Late Luteal/PMS); (6) Content sourced from shared /app/frontend/src/utils/phaseContent.js — Luteal card key maps to PHASE_CONTENT['Early Luteal'] and PMS to PHASE_CONTENT['Late Luteal/PMS'] internally while displaying standard names externally.
